analysis:
Integration pass over the PR: CHANGELOG.md (v0.10.1 candidate section, head lines 11-138 plus unchanged historical notes), removed changelog.d fragments, docs/operations/provider-release.md, and the one-line version bump in ProviderCore.swift line 8 (0.10.0 to 0.10.1). Replayed source units are the removed fragments (documentation only). No executable security control, crypto, attestation, App Attest, WebSocket, cache or fan-helper code changed in the supplied evidence, so I found no concrete regression. The historical changelog entries on T-041 (30-minute TTL, HMAC lookup names, account-scoped salts) match the canonical threat model with no drift.

Unverified contracts for code reviewers, described in prose but with no source here:
1. The verified-weights cache (~/.darkbloom/verified-weights.json) reuses the last verified GLM hash while device, inode, size, mtime and ctime are unchanged. It relates to T-012, T-027 and A-004. It is an operator-writable trust anchor. The change also drops the separate weight-hash passes. Check the owner-only mode, how a forged or edited record is handled, and the TOCTOU between hashing and loading.
2. The desktop control API (`darkbloom desktop serve`, a loopback LaunchAgent with a read-only dashboard session and a `desktop_account` device-code purpose) is new local attack surface. It is not modelled in TB-003 or A-008. Review its token custody, CSRF and DNS-rebinding defenses, the loopback bind, and the isolation of provider credentials. The threat model may need an update.
3. Page-cache accounting that counts more memory as available affects load admission and KV budgets (T-029 and availability).
4. GLM JSON, tool-choice and logprob changes: confirm that 422 paths withhold content on failure (T-008). The Nemotron 40 MiB media bound and the GLM variable-frame-rate video parser add media-parser and memory surface (T-050).
5. Rollout depends on coordinator darkbloom-platform#411. Without it, logprob requests reach a 0.10.0 GLM provider and return 500, which cools providers. This is a platform-owned availability contract that I cannot verify.
6. The installer relaxes its signature check for dev/staging pre-release versions (CHANGELOG ~669-685). Confirm scripts/install.sh cannot reach this on production version strings (T-054, A-017).
7. The mlx-swift-lm pin bump (7bed8216 to 6148b6da) needs review.

The source for items 1-4, 6 and 7 is in other batches; the omitted replay units mean this pass is not a full audit.
